subject.title: Add Claw status and remove lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw core expose `claws status` and destructive `claws remove` now, with warning-only artifact removal and hash-guarded managed-file deletion semantics?
rationale: This adds a new user-facing lifecycle and destructive state/workspace cleanup behavior over an unshipped Claws stack, so product and upgrade semantics need maintainer intent even though the inspected patch looks coherent.

options.title: Proceed After Stack Review
options.body: Accept the status/remove lifecycle once the preceding Claws PRs and upgrade proof are reviewed together.

options.title: Narrow To Status First
options.body: Keep inspection/status but defer destructive remove until rollback, ref-counting, or docs semantics are settled.

options.title: Pause Core Lifecycle
options.body: Keep the stack open but do not add core lifecycle commands until the RFC direction is explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Stack Review
recommendation.body: Accept the status/remove lifecycle once the preceding Claws PRs and upgrade proof are reviewed together.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main adjacent owner for CLI/state boundaries among the likely owners found.
